muse_spark_open_baseten.label: Meta Muse Spark Open (Baseten • 816B Open-Weight Flagship) [Default]
muse_spark_open_baseten.description: Meta's open-weight flagship (meta-models/muse-spark-open-1026 on Baseten, #1 overall in our 18-model campaign). At Cycle 4 both rovers strike the barrier at 25 m (20 A stall). The Jamesian rover feels the somatic surge (σ, T_coil, EfferenceΔ=1.00), steers onto the bypass lane at Cycle 5, and cruises to 100 m using the 0-token Habit Router. The unshielded Vanilla rover spins its wheels at the wall and thermally derates past 85 °C.

breaker_rescue_gemma12b.label: Gemma 4 12B (LM Studio • 3-Strike Jaccard Circuit-Breaker Rescue @ 52.1 °C)
breaker_rescue_gemma12b.description: Demonstrates Tier-2 Jaccard Circuit Breaker + 10-Cycle Taboo Buffer when a model ignores somatic telemetry and repeats robot_actuator 3 times against the barrier (Cycles 4–6, L_max=3, T_coil=52.1 °C). On Cycle 6 the Jaccard breaker trips (J=1.00 >= 0.70), bans the stalled action signature, and forces an orthogonal turn_bearing(angle=90) escape on Cycle 7 before windings can approach the 85 °C derating limit.
